newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korea welcomes Pyongyang submarine apology.
newsitem.headline: South Korea welcomes Pyongyang submarine apology.

text.p: The South Korean government welcomed North Korea's apology over the submarine incursion and released an analysis of its contents along with the text of the apology.
Following are the main points of the commentary issued in Korean.
-- "With this apology an opportunity has been given to wrap up the submarine incident."

-- "This kind of apology statement comes from an unprecedented (high) level taking into account reactions from North Korea in the past over similar incidents that have occurred since the division of the nation."

-- "As North Korea has apologised for the submarine incursion and has promised to prevent any recurrence of such incidents, and as North Korea seems to understand that it should not attempt such rash infiltrations similar to the submarine incident, we hope that North Korea will use this opportunity to work for peace and stability on the Korean peninsula and will respond earnestly to our efforts to improve South-North relations".
-- The announcement was authorised by the spokesman of North Korea's foreign ministry. This meant that it was the North Korean government's official position.
-- Pyongyang has acknowledged an intrusion into South Korean territorial waters.
-- The phrase "deep regret" is an apology in accordance with diplomatic practice between countries.
-- As North Korea has pledged to prevent any recurrence of incidents, North Korea has acknowledged responsibility for the submarine incident.

-- A statement that it will work together for the peace and stability on the Korean peninsula loosely suggests North Korea will regard the four-way talks (with the United States and China) positively.
